user_input: Work directly in the repository d:\Projects\SpecMind-AI and implement the complete remaining backlog for the SpecMind AI two-mode product. The user explicitly asked to do all todos first. Product requirements: Pitch mode generates a complete structured SRS with stable IDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, UML/architecture diagrams, quality/confidence scores, suggestions, and combined exports. Upload/improve mode accepts PDF/DOCX, preserves original, extracts/analyzes requirements and test cases, identifies ambiguity/omissions/risks, asks clarification questions, suggests and refactors into an improved SRS, generates diagrams/scores/reports/exports. Existing app is FastAPI/PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy/Alembic/Gemini backend and React/Vite frontend. Implement canonical schemas, provider abstraction/fake-testable AI service, versioned prompts, workflow endpoints, persistence or coherent JSON artifact persistence, safe storage/parser behavior, readiness/CORS/config, exports/fallbacks, full frontend flows, docs, tests, and no secret exposure. Authentication can remain client-local but document it. Do not merely report a plan; eventually edit the repository. For this invocation, only run the clarification gate and return its READY/NEEDS_INPUT/BLOCKED token. Classification: brownfield rewrite, grouping_needed=false, target stack is the existing FastAPI/PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy/Alembic/Gemini backend plus React/Vite frontend, frontend and backend are both in scope. Project facts: approximately 1675 nonblank source LOC, Python backend under backend/app with migrations/tests, JavaScript frontend under frontend/src with Vite, docs directories for product/architecture/API/database/AI/testing/deployment. Feasibility: feasible with staged implementation and deterministic fallbacks.
title: Complete SpecMind AI two-mode product backlog

assessment_snapshot.intro: The supplied scenario covers a brownfield full-stack rewrite/implementation of an existing SpecMind AI product with two workflows:
bullets: Frontend: React/Vite application is in scope, but no target UI component library, screenshots, design-token source, browser matrix, or responsive strategy is specified.
Backend: FastAPI/PostgreSQL/SQLAlchemy/Alembic/Gemini is specified, but API compatibility, data migration policy, and non-functional targets are not fully defined.
Product behavior: Pitch and Upload/improve capabilities, deterministic fallbacks, exports, local authentication, and testing are described at a high level.

proposed_outcome: Complete the remaining SpecMind AI backlog in the existing repository, preserving the original source where required, delivering production-quality Pitch and Upload/improve flows across the React/Vite frontend and FastAPI backend, with stable schemas, safe persistence and parsing, testable AI-provider boundaries, documented local authentication, exports, tests, and deterministic fallback behavior.
